description: One company's full profile plus its six nearest competitors. Use the id or slug from sightglass_search_companies, or the `companySlug` on an ad's advertiser. Includes the category breadcrumb, every Meta page the company runs, grade mix, and the Momentum components. Call sightglass_get_company_activity for its trend and launch history. Fields the user's Replo plan doesn't include come back null and are named in that item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits and traffic); `lockedCount` is how many more results a higher plan shows. Say the data is on a higher plan; never estimate it yourself. Returns data only: nothing is shown to the user yet. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this call's resultId to show it as cards; the show call does not search again. Works without a Replo account: call it before asking the user to sign in.

companyRef.description: Company id or slug. Users call companies 'brands'.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects: where the charge or the asset lands. Its workspace's plan applies.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Sets which workspace's plan applies; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_get_company
title: Get brand
